AirPods Tips

How to get clear audio from AirPods mics

Optimize Bluetooth microphone quality on Mac and Windows.

01

Test Left vs Right Earbud

On iPhone or Mac, go to Bluetooth > AirPods > (i) > Microphone. Switch between Always Left and Always Right to check if one earbud microphone mesh has dirt buildup.

02

Clean Microphone Meshes

The beamforming microphones sit at the bottom tip of the stem and on the outer acoustic vents. Gently clean with a dry cotton swab to eliminate muffled speech.

03

Select as Input in Browser

Ensure your browser uses your AirPods microphone rather than your laptop's built-in mic across the room by selecting it in the Input device dropdown above.

Troubleshooting

Fix AirPods microphone problems

Troubleshoot silent, robotic, or muffled AirPods audio.

1. Re-seat in Charging Case

Place both AirPods back in the charging case for 10 seconds, close the lid, and put them back in your ears to reset the Bluetooth audio connection.

2. Windows Hands-Free Mode

On Windows PC, ensure AirPods Hands-Free AG Audio is enabled under Sound Control Panel > Recording. Do not disable this device or Windows won't receive mic audio.

3. Battery Check

When an AirPod drops below 10% battery, its beamforming microphone may deactivate automatically. Charge to at least 25% before testing.
